newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Turin starts city utility sale procedure.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Turin starts city utility sale procedure.

text.p: The northwest Italian city of Turin on Tuesday formally launched procedures to sell off 43 percent of the municipal power utility AEM di Torino SpA to a strategic partner for the heating and electricity company.
The city said in a statement that it expected to choose a purchaser in 1998.
Italian bank IMI and Barclays Plc's investment banking arm BZW were named as advisors for the privatisation operation in February.
AEM (Azienda Energetica Municipale) made a net profit of 14 billion lire in 1996 on turnover of 311 billion lire.
Based on 1996 estimates, the city expects to raise some 300 billion lire from the sale.
